# Phone PC Remote

> Android app for controlling a Windows 11 or Ubuntu 24.04+ computer or a supported smart TV on a local network.

- [Official downloads and setup](https://nilsenj.github.io/phone-pc-remote/): Google Play, Microsoft Store, Ubuntu beta, and pairing instructions.
- [AI setup guide](https://nilsenj.github.io/phone-pc-remote/ai.html): Local MCP connector, client configuration, tools, and troubleshooting.
- [Releases and checksums](https://github.com/nilsenj/phone-pc-remote-releases/releases): Public release notes and download assets.
- [Privacy policy](https://nilsenj.github.io/phone-pc-remote/privacy.html): Data handling and support.
